meta.dependencyStrategy: Bundled transitive source files, relocatable static JSON

docs: Import the installed lib/theme/styles.css once after Tailwind. Wrap your app with Theme from your configured lib alias + /theme/theme. Portals inherit Theme. Sources use the system font stack; no font network request. Files include the complete local dependency closure; no namespace or host-bound dependency URLs.
